findings.title: R35 does not freeze an implementation-neutral RED-to-GREEN harness for Design-authorized API closure
findings.fact: DESIGN-P2-R32 explicitly permits raw/proofless API removal or visibility reduction as well as retention of an internal primitive guarded by opaque authorization. R35 requires the six MANDATORY_RED tests to become GREEN but several raw/proofless cases are still described through direct calls to APIs that R32 allows Development to remove or hide.
findings.risk: A compliant production fix could turn a genuine pre-fix RED into a post-fix test compilation failure, indirectly forcing Development to preserve a bypass API solely to keep the RED source compilable or encouraging unreviewed test rewriting.
findings.requiredRemediation: Keep the same six MANDATORY_RED Case IDs and classifications, but make the final raw/proofless oracle implementation-neutral: ordinary caller cannot reach a usable raw seam OR a retained internal primitive rejects absent/mismatched Guard authorization before effect. Freeze RED test-source digest and a controlled, independently TestEvidence-reviewed harness-delta rule when R32-authorized API closure requires post-fix test adaptation.

evidenceFacts: DESIGN-P2-R32 R32-3 allows beginSession/effectProvider/raw operation-port extraction to stop forming a public chain and allows proofless factories to be removed/closed or converted to non-executable transport.
Current RuntimeModelAccessScope exposes public beginSession() and effectProvider().
Current ResolvedProtectedReadAccess and ResolvedProtectedWriteAccess expose proofless public factories.
Current ProductionCompositionCoordinator still uses RuntimeBindingPlan.equals() for captured-context ownership.
canonicalLifecycleNote: Do not append R35 as the final PASSED candidate. Reopen TestDesign I008 from historical R34, treat R35 as reviewed candidate with P2-TD-REV-002, produce/review R36, then finalize I008 only after R36 PASSED.
